seasons.summary: The tournament was hosted in South Africa.
Chennai defended the title at home.
Mumbai won its first IPL title.
Kolkata chased down a high-scoring final.
Chennai returned from suspension and won.
Mumbai edged Chennai by one run.
The season was played in the UAE.
Gujarat won in its debut season.
Bengaluru won its first IPL title.

seasons.playerOfSeason: Virat Kohli (final Player of the Match)
seasons.summary: Royal Challengers Bengaluru defended their title by chasing Gujarat Titans' 155/8 and reaching 161/5 in 18 overs. Gujarat finished runner-up after reaching a third final in five seasons; their title count remains one, from 2022.
